expectation: Nuclear stain in intestinal epithelium: nearly all crypt and villus epithelial nuclei lit, lining glands and surface. Stroma, muscle and lymphoid cells stay negative. Common where there is intestinal or metaplastic epithelium, absent elsewhere.
observed: A: yellow haze over the whole section, muscle included, with tile stripes. B, C: epithelial nuclei blue and unstained, yellow in stroma and cytoplasm around them. D: blobs between nuclei. E1: cytoplasmic and membranous net with dark nuclei. E2: no Ecadherin structure.
why: The signal covers the whole tissue and sits outside the epithelial nuclei, where CDX2 belongs, so no specific nuclear population shows.
notes: CDX2 lights stroma, muscle and cytoplasm, with tile stripes in the muscle, while the epithelial nuclei in B, C and E1 stay unstained. The bright spots are blobs between nuclei. Ecadherin shows no structure, so row E adds nothing.
